summary: Short steep kerb at a junction mouth beside a main road, with no room to stop.
reasons: Junction with islands and give-way markings

drivers.seclusion: Bush to the south and houses 34 m or more away, but the stretch is in the open junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is a turning area beside a traffic island; a van would block the junction.
drivers.traffic: Busy main road alongside; vehicles turning through the junction.
drivers.convention: No parked vehicles seen along this kerb.

flags: Junction mouth, a van would block turning traffic
sun_shade: Open at the junction; tree canopy to the south.
